title: We got admin access to Baseten's production GitHub
summary: Security researcher from Strix discovered and responsibly disclosed a critical vulnerability in Baseten's Harbor container registry that allowed unauthorized access to their production GitHub repository through exposed Personal Access Tokens (PATs), potentially compromising their entire production infrastructure.
problem_solved: Exposed or improperly secured GitHub Personal Access Tokens in a container registry that led to complete production environment compromise.
why_valuable: This responsible disclosure demonstrates a critical supply chain vulnerability pattern where container image credentials can be extracted to gain full production access, helping organizations understand and secure their infrastructure.
